identity.name: Coal Letter
identity.summary: A folded charcoal paper letter with a red wax flame seal.
identity.description: Costs 1 mana per activation. Deals 4 magical damage per affordable activation. Applies 1 burn through the existing combat keyword rules per affordable activation.
identity.lore: Its sender wrote only the word warm.

effects.description: Costs 1 mana per activation. Deals 4 magical damage per affordable activation. Applies 1 burn through the existing combat keyword rules per affordable activation.
effects.condition: Equipped; class restriction satisfied; all activation costs can be paid together.

synergies.description: Its fire trace participates in the Elementalist's existing reaction system; arrange it with spells of another element. No extra reaction beyond the shared rules is added.
